known_issues: Cinematic moving background is not visible / animation not rendering as expected.

existing_features.title: Make the site-wide CinematicBackground canvas reliably visible behind all content on every page by fixing stacking context/z-index layering so it is not rendered behind the document/background or covered by opaque section backgrounds.

Update HeroSection so its local 'Cinematic Background' overlay does not fully obscure the global CinematicBackground (e.g., remove the opaque `bg-dark` backdrop or make it transparent/low-opacity while keeping any intended decorative overlays).

Improve CinematicBackground rendering quality and robustness: account for devicePixelRatio in canvas sizing, ensure the canvas covers the viewport via CSS sizing (width/height 100%), and keep animation running smoothly with safe cleanup on unmount.

Add an accessibility/performance fallback for the cinematic background that respects `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` by rendering a static frame (or a static gradient) instead of running requestAnimationFrame.

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement a visible, proper cinematic moving background (ensure animation renders correctly)

projectName: Fix cinematic moving background visibility and make it clearly animated site-wide
